critical_code_review_comments: Sales.jsx head-tab styling: active tab uses bg-plate/text-white with border-plate — matches 'near-black plate' spec and is consistent between Verify/Cancellations custom buttons and the HeadTab component (Plots/Site).
Modal component (components/ui.jsx) Escape-to-close is confirmed working for both PlotDrilldown and ReceiptDialog — resolves the a11y nit called out in iteration 21.
Summary panel typography uses large serif (font-display) with mono-num for values — matches editorial language.
Role gating unchanged: post_sales does not see head-verify/head-cancellations; accounts sees all four; admin sees all four. Verified via UI.
Maker-checker flow intact: pending receipt does NOT count in received until Accounts YES; after YES the received total updates. UI badges reflect verification_status correctly (VERIFIED vs Pending).

Sales.jsx is ~488 lines — approaching the split-threshold in code review guidelines. Consider extracting PlotDrilldown / ReceiptDialog / VerificationQueue / CancellationsView into their own files for maintainability (non-blocking).
